recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39022; any future cleanup of the legacy core ValueSet/list-order or List.orderedBy binding should be handled by a separate tracker with explicit work-group approval.
issue_request: The Applied FHIR-core issue originally asked for changes to EvidenceReport and for adding publication-date to ListOrderCodes. Its final Persuasive with Modification resolution states that EvidenceReport had been removed from the specification and redirects the substantive change to CodeSystem: List Order Codes with descriptions generalized beyond the List resource.
initial_application: No prior FHIR-core commit tagged with FHIR-39022 was found. EvidenceReport was already disconnected and de-listed by commit 050832a81c, and the list-order terminology work was later implemented outside core in THO through UTG proposal UP-739.
additional_context: Current core source has no EvidenceReport resource folder or active fhir.ini registration. Core still carries a legacy http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/list-order under the active List resource that composes the THO CodeSystem/list-order, while FHIR-53167 separately moved Composition.section.orderedBy to the THO ValueSet/list-order canonical. Published THO version 2.0.0 now includes publication-date and the generalized description requested by FHIR-39022/UP-739.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source was changed. The remaining approved work belongs to the external THO/UTG terminology repository and has already been applied there; changing or retiring the remaining legacy core ValueSet/list-order canonical would require a separate core/terminology decision.

related_jiras.note: UTG/THO proposal sponsored from FHIR-39022 that implemented publication-date and generalized list-order descriptions outside the FHIR core checkout.
Separate Composition tracker changed Composition.section.orderedBy to bind to the THO ValueSet/list-order canonical, confirming non-List use now points to THO.
